deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is January 31 for admission; Priority 2 is April 15. The page gives no department-specific deadline.

gre_general.value: Chemistry catalog: GRE is required for PhD applicants; no minimum score is given in the text fetched.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is required for PhD applicants.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry catalog minimum is TOEFL iBT 80 (internet-based), 213 (computer-based) or 550 (paper-based).

supervisor.value: No official page says a supervisor must be agreed before admission.

funding.value: Departmental funding goes to a limited number of applicants at admission, per the Graduate College.
funding.quote: Departmental funding is awarded to a limited number of highly qualified, full-time students at the time of admission.

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to hold a bachelor's degree in chemistry or a closely allied major.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution with a major in that same discipline

notes: After admission, PhD students join a research group and form a four-member Supervisory Committee by the end of semester two; this is not an admission rule.
